lang: python

---
def download(url, output, expected_sha256, expected_size):
    if output.exists():
        try:
            validate_planetary_spk(
                output,
                expected_sha256=expected_sha256,
                expected_size=expected_size,
            )
        except (OSError, SpkValidationError):
            pass
        else:
            print(f"already present: {output}")
            return output
    fetch_and_write(url, output)
    return output
